root_cause: CMake's strict source-listing check (_ov_check_all_sources_listed) for the ov_gpu_unit_tests target fails because two test .cpp files under src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/transformations/ exist on disk but are not enumerated in the target's sources (glob/list in CMakeLists.txt or sources.cmake). This is unrelated to the current PR's changes (a clang-tidy brace-style pass over intel_gpu headers/primitives) and stems from a separate, earlier change to the GPU unit test file list/CMakeLists that did not add the new/renamed test files. The identical signature was previously observed twice on PR #37914 (a different PR), confirming this is a base-branch (master) issue that any merge-queue run building the GPU unit tests will hit, not something introduced by PR 37208.
reproduction_steps: cd build && cmake -DENABLE_TESTS=ON <other GPU-enabling flags> ../src && re-run configure; observe CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/add_target_helpers.cmake:635 for group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp and remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp under src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/transformations/.
recommended_actions: Add group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp and remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp to src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/CMakeLists.txt (or the sources.cmake/glob list it includes) so they are compiled into ov_gpu_unit_tests.
Since this is unrelated to PR 37208's own changes, rebase/merge master once the fix lands, or ask maintainers to land the CMakeLists.txt fix on master directly.
Consider re-running the merge-queue check once master is fixed rather than modifying PR 37208 itself.
prevention_strategies: Enable the _ov_check_all_sources_listed check locally (or in a pre-commit/pre-push hook) whenever new test files are added under src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/, and require CI on the introducing PR to build the GPU unit tests target before merge so this class of omission is caught before entering the merge queue.
historical_context: Identical signature previously recorded twice for PR #37914 (runs 34188369195 and 34194664069), also unrelated to that PR's own changes. This is the third occurrence within the tracking window, confirming a persistent unresolved issue on master's GPU unit test CMakeLists.
